analysis.headline: USD/KRW retreats to 1,336.9 as post-election rally pauses and exporters sell dollars
analysis.summary: USD/KRW fell to around 1,336.9 (ECB ref 1,336.90) as the post-election dollar rally paused and U.S. Treasury yields stabilized. A rebound in global tech equities and massive dollar sales (nego) by Korean exporters above 1,335 KRW fueled won gains. Trading settled in a 1,333–1,342 KRW range as markets consolidated ahead of October U.S. inflation data.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW breaks below 1,500 to 1,487.6 as robust won rally outpaces EUR/USD
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW retreated sharply to around 1,487.6 (ECB ref 1,487.57), decisively breaking beneath the 1,500 KRW psychological threshold. While EUR/USD hovered around 1.1127 amid persistent concerns over European economic growth, the Korean won appreciated significantly faster in Seoul. Heavy exporter dollar conversions and tech optimism pressured the cross lower into a 1,483–1,495 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW falls to 839.6 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY holds near 158 and won rallies
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW slipped to around 8.40 KRW per JPY (~839.6 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.396). USD/JPY traded near 157–158 due to ongoing U.S.-Japan rate differentials, though verbal intervention warnings from Tokyo and BOJ rate hike prospects capped yen downside. With the Korean won advancing rapidly on improving semiconductor exports, the cross softened into the 836–844 KRW range.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW slides to 1,779.0 despite solid foundation from BoE 4.0% bank rate
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW slid to around 1,779.0 (ECB ref 1,779.01), retreating below the 1,780 KRW mark. The Bank of England’s hawkish stance following its rate hike to 4.0% and steady cable trading provided underlying support for sterling. Nevertheless, relentless dollar liquidation by Korean exporters and broad risk appetite fueled a strong won rally, pulling the cross down within a 1,774–1,786 KRW band.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW dips to 200.4 as PBOC liquidity supports amidst extended won gains
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW adjusted lower toward 200.4 (ECB ref 200.41) within a 199.8–201.2 KRW range. The PBOC maintained accommodative liquidity injections and stable reference fixings, while expectations for fiscal stimulus from the NPC provided baseline support. However, as USD/KRW dropped toward 1,336.9 in Seoul on strong domestic export flows, the cross followed lower to test the 200.0 KRW support level.

AUD.headline: AUD slips to 917.0 KRW as won gains overshadow RBA hawkish stance
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar softened to 917.0 KRW as broad Korean won strength and tech export optimism eclipsed the support from the RBA’s restrictive policy stance and stable commodity markets.

CAD.headline: CAD drops to 939.2 KRW pressured by BoC easing bias and won rally
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar dropped to 939.2 KRW, weighed down by the Bank of Canada’s dovish rate trajectory and oil price fluctuations, while aggressive exporter dollar selling boosted the won.

CHF.headline: CHF eases to 1,611.0 KRW as revived risk appetite cools safe-haven demand
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc receded to 1,611.0 KRW as safe-haven bids subsided amid a tech-led equity rebound, while USD/KRW’s continued descent into the mid-1,330s pulled the cross lower.

CNY.headline: CNY softens to 200.4 KRW as won appreciation counters PBOC stimulus
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan eased to 200.4 KRW as the broader won rally in Seoul offset supportive liquidity operations by the PBOC and optimistic fiscal stimulus expectations from the NPC.

EUR.headline: EUR breaks below 1,500 to 1,487.6 KRW as won surge dominates cross rate
EUR.brief: The euro fell to 1,487.6 KRW, breaking below the 1,500 KRW floor as rapid won appreciation driven by semiconductor exports far outpaced subdued EUR/USD trading around 1.1127.

GBP.headline: GBP retreats to 1,779.0 KRW despite support from 4.0% BoE bank rate
GBP.brief: The British pound slid to 1,779.0 KRW as intense exporter dollar selling in Seoul drove a broad won surge, outweighing sterling’s yield advantage from the BoE’s 4.0% policy rate.

HKD.headline: HKD edges down to 170.4 KRW tracking USD/KRW decline within peg band
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar eased to 170.4 KRW within its 7.75–7.85 HKD peg band, closely reflecting the softer U.S. dollar and broad Korean won gains in the Seoul session.

JPY.headline: JPY falls to 839.6 per 100 JPY on wide yield gap and aggressive won gains
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen dropped to 839.6 KRW per 100 JPY as elevated USD/JPY near 158 and persistent yield divergence left the yen trailing behind the won’s strong export-driven rally.

KRW.headline: KRW rallies to 1,336.9 vs USD led by robust tech exports and exporter sales
KRW.brief: The Korean won strengthened to 1,336.9 per USD on heavy exporter dollar liquidation above 1,335 KRW and thriving semiconductor shipments as post-election dollar momentum calmed.

USD.headline: USD drops to 1,336.9 KRW as post-election momentum fades ahead of CPI
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar fell to 1,336.9 KRW as Treasury yields stabilized and local exporters unloaded dollar holdings above 1,335 KRW while markets awaited October U.S. inflation figures.
